connector.name: Lune Research
connector.registryDescription: Search peer-reviewed papers and research methodology guidance from your AI agent.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.luneresearch.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package lune-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.luneresearch, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token. Use a Lune PAT or an OAuth access token from https://luneresearch.com/dashboard/credentials.

env.name: LUNE_API_KEY
env.description: Lune personal access token. Generate one at https://luneresearch.com/dashboard/credentials.
